metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a specialized Maven plugin development initialization skill with distinct semantic identity (plugin-specific Mojo API integration, plugin descriptor configuration, plugin testing harness) that differs materially from peer candidates which cover general Maven project initialization, configuration, and dependency resolution. Peer candidates address broader Maven scaffolding and setup; candidate targets the narrower, specialized domain of plugin development infrastructure. No existing skills in the registry match this plugin development focus. Candidate is supported by documentation evidence and contains no conflicts.
